characters.name: Brisco County Jr.
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: The Ace: Quickly develops a reputation as the best bounty hunter in the West, his exploits even becoming novelized. His heroism and accomplishments are so great, they remain renowned thousands of years into the future. Because Destiny Says So: A lot of this Orb business involves others telling him he is fated to confront Bly and protect the Orbs. To his frustration, those same folks only give him hints rather than actual details, leaving him to sort it all out. Commonality Connection:He jumped to Professor Wickwire's defense the second there was trouble, but what really made them fast friends was how they both have a love of advancing technology and are always looking to see what's developing.He immediately takes an interest in Whip Morgan, recognizing him as aShadow Archetype(mourns a dead loved one, but wants revenge instead of justice) and acting as a mentor figure to try to keep him on the right path. He jumped to Professor Wickwire's defense the second there was trouble, but what really made them fast friends was how they both have a love of advancing technology and are always looking to see what's developing. He immediately takes an interest in Whip Morgan, recognizing him as aShadow Archetype(mourns a dead loved one, but wants revenge instead of justice) and acting as a mentor figure to try to keep him on the right path.

characters.name: Lord Bowler
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Always Second Best: Lord Bowler is an incredible bounty hunter who develops a big reputation of his own, but he is still forever seen as Brisco’s faithful sidekick. Dark and Troubled Past: SufferedHalf-Breed Discriminationall his life, has aFriendless Backgroundthat made him rather bitter, saw some action while serving in the 10th Cavalry, and had a romantic interest he couldn't pursue due to uncertainty about her husband's survival (and the guy turned out to beDead All Along, anyway). Dude, Where's My Respect?: To his increasing frustration, he is known primarily as Brisco's "faithful companion" rather than as a successful bounty hunter in his own right. Embarrassing First Name: Andlast name, too, according to him. His real name is James Longfeather, and his sole explanation for changing it isIt's a Long Story. Everyone Has Standards:Despite his dislike of Brisco early on, Lord Bowler balks at the idea of selling him out to outlaws like Big Smith.He is a religious man, so he is outraged at the idea of friend or foe using guns in a church.

characters.name: Socrates Pool
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Because Destiny Says So: He learns in "Foutain of Youth" of his own small but pivotal role in the Orb storyline:previously giving Brisco his father's gun, as the ivory handle contains the only way to stop an empowered Bly. Character Development: While definitely not a coward, Socrates was still a pretty meek man who would let the robber barons order him around without question. As the show goes, on grows much more a backbone and is willing to call out his bosses even if it threatens his job. Cowardly Lion: He is always terrified of the chaos that happens around him, but he is unrelentingly loyal to Brisco and is capable of some surprising feats when push comes to shove. To Be Lawful or Good: Faces this problem when the robber barons tell him to forget about Brisco when he gets capture and find them a new bounty hunter. Socrates chooses to be good and save his friend.

characters.name: Dixie Cousins
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: All Girls Want Bad Boys: Deconstructed. From a young age she had a lot of flings with really awful men due to thinking their badness made them distinguished. After the death of her most recent boyfriend Big Smith, she begins to realize she has ended up regretting every single one of these abusive relationships, and so she becomes a case ofSingle Woman Seeks Good Man, with her eyes especially set on Brisco. Characterization Marches On: Though aToken Good Teammateto the criminals around her, for her first couple of appearances Dixie was still a shifty character with shady plans. Her moral ambiguity would quickly be discarded in favor of making her sincerely heroic, to such a degree her going briefly back to crime shocks everyone. Dark and Troubled Past: Her parents were intending to settle out west, but she was abducted during a Cherokee attack. Mennonites eventually rescued her, but they would later die of yellow fever, leaving her on her own. Dixie ended up at a mission, where she trained to be a nun for 15 years before backing out and pursuing a career in show business, where she had a host of relationships with unsavory men. Embarrassing First Name: Her real first name is Myra, to Brisco's surprise. The Glorious War of Sisterly Rivalry: With her sister, Dolly. They followed very similar paths (getting abducted by Native Americans, becoming singers), which Dixie felt was Dolly deliberately copying and trying to one up her. Dolly's also not above flirting with Brisco just to get a rise out of Dixie.

characters.name: Comet
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Amplified Animal Aptitude: In thePilot Movie, Brisco says Comet thinks he's human, and the horse certainly acts like it. He often demonstrates an awareness of exactly what's going on (including when people are being sarcastic towards him), can find his way into buildings with closed doors to find exactly where Brisco is, follows specific commands to the letter, and has "conversations" with Brisco. Automaton Horses: Averted. The show often makes it a point that as tough as Comet is he can't constantly chase outlaws, and we frequently see Brisco taking care of Comet or stopping to let him rest. The only time this is played straight is in one episode when Comet is able to match a motorcycle in speed. Intelligible Unintelligible: He can't actually talk, yet Brisco regularly has conversations with him and always knows what he means.[Comet neighs]Brisco:No, Comet, you're not a suspect.[Comet neighs again]Brisco:When I said the killer was an animal, I didn't mean the four-legged kind. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: He will make life difficult for Brisco when offended and can be incredibly stubborn, but he always comes to Brisco's aide no matter how hairy things get. Trademark Favorite Food: Helovesapples. The only way someone other than Brisco can get him to listen is to give him an apple.

characters.name: Professor Albert Wickwire
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Commonality Connection: He's immediately pleasant to Brisco as with anyone else, but the two become fast friends over learning they share a love of advancing technology. Cool Old Guy: An older fellow who is constantly nice to everyone and working on new inventions for the good of the world. Cool Teacher: When he's not bumping into Brisco as part of an adventure, he's teaching courses at a university and bringing the same quirky energy for any lessons. Ditzy Genius: He can build and upgrade an assortment of technology quite advanced for the time. He even managed to gain some understanding of the mysterious Orb just by studying one for a few hours, something even government scientists were unable to do. However, he often spaces out, displays a variety of quirks, and doesn't realize how crazy he can come across. Everyone Has Standards: He admits the chance to study one of the mysterious Orbs is quite tempting, but he refuses to do a monster like Bly any favors. Bly forces his hand by threatening to kill a young hostage.

characters.name: Professor Ogden Coles
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: But Now I Must Go: After using an Orb to save Brisco's life, he performs aStealth Hi/Byeto get it out of town before Bly can claim it. In-between appearances, he hid it in a secret location. Knight of Cerebus: A benevolent example. The episodes the Professor pops up in are always more serious given they always involve the Orbs. Mr. Exposition: As someone who has studied the orbs for years, he is usually the one to detail information on them. Not So Above It All: He used the power of the Orbs to help an ailing Lillian. He admits that was a mistake and that he should've been more responsible with the great power he was guarding, but Lillian was after all family.

characters.name: Whip Morgan
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: The Bro Code: He was quite smitten with Dixie and considered making a move. Once he learned Brisco already had a relationship with her, he was deeply apologetic and backed off. Butt-Monkey: Whip has a habit of getting in over his head, which always results in him being humiliated. Character Development: He gets more mature with each of his appearances. He also learns to trust Brisco more: in his first appearance he can be barely be controlled, but in this next he is completely willing to follow Brisco without objection. Hot-Blooded: With his fragile ego and short-temper, it isn't hard at all to get Whip going. Luke, I Am Your Father: An interesting case where the child is aware but the parent isn’t: Whip Is Roy Hondo’s son.

characters.name: The Robber Barons
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Reasonable Authority Figure: Mr. Emmerson. When the other robber barons weren't interested in having Brisco work for them due to his unorthodox behavior, Mr. Emmerson immediately stands up and hires Brisco. Through the rest of the series he proves to be the most wise and moral of the robber barons. Token Evil Teammate: The robber barons overall are a mostly corrupt bunch, but not outright evil. The one exception is Mr. Thorogood, an especially greedy man who betrays the good guys to work with Bly,though it doesn't quite work out for him.

characters.name: The President
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Reasonable Authority Figure: Especially when compared to the robber barons, the President is a strong and helpful leader. For example; when it was believed that Brisco had gone rogue the robber barons extended no help to him, but later when it was believed that Brisco had literally betrayed the United States, the President didn't believe a word of it and was willing to bend laws to help get him to safety.

characters.name: John Bly
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: The Chessmaster: He is famed as a master at manipulating other people to his advantage. The Dreaded:Everyoneis afraid of him; Brisco, Bowler, bounty hunters, other outlaws, the government, and even other time travelers. Evil Cannot Comprehend Good: Averted. He recognizes Brisco would never sacrifice an innocent to bring him to justice and exploits that more than once to get away. Faux Affably Evil: He can put on a show of being quite eloquent with underlings, enemies, and captives, but he can turn deadly violent at the drop of a hat. I Control My Minions Through…: Fear. His main gang and the assorted mooks do whatever he asks, all while dreading how he'll react to failure. Even the taller and more outwardly meaner Big Smith admitted to being scared of the guy.

characters.name: Pete Hutter
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Berserk Button: Donottouch Pete’s piece. Butt-Monkey: Nothing ever goes right for Pete. Even ignoring the running gag of him dying constantly, he gets humiliated and foiled in each of his appearances. Hazy–Feel Turn: In the two-part finale he helps the heroes after Brisco gets him out of jail and even begins to develop a friendship with some of them, though he remains just as maniacal and violent. No One Could Survive That!: ARunning Gagis Pete seemingly getting killed at the end of an episode, but somehow surviving. In the span of the show he is shot multiple times, drowned, flattened by a boulder, stabbed by a Chinese throwing star, and impaled by a pitchfork; and every time, he pops up again later perfectly fine.

characters.name: Roy Hondo
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Pet the Dog: He has a chance to kill Whip when he spares him, but ultimately he can’t go through with killing his own son. Afterward, he has a sincere heart-to-heart with Whip, asking him to become a better man than he ever was. The Stoic: Always speaks in a calm voice and is constantly level-headed. The only time hiscalmness breaksis when Whip confronts him and reveals he’s his son. Hondo tries to keep up an unflappable facade, but is clearly uncomfortable with fighting his own son, looking to be on the verge of tears by the end.

characters.name: The Orbs
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Artifact of Hope: Their purpose is to bring greater advancement of mankind and can only be properly wielded by those who intend to use them for good ends. Those with selfish ends will receive power, but as Thorogood demonstrates the orbs will also curse and eventually kill them. Bly himself is fully aware the orbs would never allow him to wield them, which is why one of his goals is finding someone who can figure out the orbs and allow him to bypass their defenses. Maybe Magic, Maybe Mundane: Even when the purpose of the orbs and what they are is made clear, there is a lot of mystery regarding their nature that implies they are more than just powerful gadgets. A lot of what they do can be chalked up toadvanced technology, but they also have sentience that the creators never intended and can do downright supernatural things like letting people see and talk with the dead. Those most familiar with the orbs will admit they don't fully understand them and it is even implied that their abilities came fromGod Himself. Sentient Phlebotinum: The orbs have a will of their own and can recognize the intentions of those who use them, rewarding those with selfless goals and punishing the wicked who would abuse them.

characters.name: Lillian
characters.media_title: Adventures of Brisco County Jr., The
characters.description: Death Equals Redemption: As old age takes her, she is able to abandon her obsession with being young. She begs her son not to strike a deal with Bly to give her more medicine, admitting she never should have cheated death to begin with. Her last words to Brisco are apologizing for her behavior and asking him to save her son. It's All About Me: Being brought back to her younger self made Lillian determined to stay young at any cost, being willing to manipulate Brisco and even her own son to get more medicine. Older Than He Looks: Big time. She looks like someone in her early 20’s, but her son is an old man, so Lillian is positively ancient. The only thing keeping he youthful is the medicine from the Orbs.
